newsitem.title: USA: Equal corn, soy, wheat share in exiting CRP-USDA.
newsitem.headline: Equal corn, soy, wheat share in exiting CRP-USDA.

text.p: About 60 percent of the 9.5 million acres leaving the Conservation Reserve are corn, wheat and soybean acreage, U.S. Agriculture Department officials said Thursday.
Chief economist Keith Collins said the three crops each accounted for 1 million-1.5 million of the land returning to production.
He described the returning acreage as "a relatively small amount" compared to U.S. farm totals and said the impact of the land would be "overwhelmed" by weather and market price shifts.
